messages:
mira: Quick triage notes for OrpheusX-lite onboarding (int4). Two separate regressions after conversion: (1) head-stride interleave -> KV cache position drift after ~10 tokens, (2) punctuation cluster remap causing summarization token shadowing. Dropping findings.
sam: Numbers? and exact convert command used?
mira: fp16 ppl=1.89, fp16 ROUGE-L=42.5. int4 before fixes: ppl=3.4, ROUGE-L collapsed to 29. Conversion command: 
```
python3 tools/convert_model.py \
  --src-format orpheusx \
  --dst-format gemma-compatible \
  --quant int4 \
  --vocab-map maps/orpheusx_to_gemma_punct_v2.json \
  --out /tmp/orp_gemma_int4
```
Small tokenmap excerpt (punctuation region):
```
{"44":"44","45":"900","46":"46","47":"47"}
# note: mapped id 45 -> 900 (appended cluster)
```
eli: 900 is suspicious (exporter appended cluster). That can create embedding collisions / shadow tokens. Separately, head layout?
mira: I dumped rotary/qkv heads (fp32 pre-quant) and computed a head permutation by correlating head patterns. Found an even-then-odd pattern: perm = list(range(0,H,2)) + list(range(1,H,2)). Essentially even-then-odd interleave.
priya: That's consistent with some exporters that write even indices then odd. Fix is to reorder heads to contiguous before quantizing. Also normalize vocab map so punctuation ids map within expected block.
mira: Implemented reorder and vocab normalization locally. Reorder snippet used: 
```
H = num_heads
perm = list(range(0,H,2)) + list(range(1,H,2))
# apply: tensor = tensor[perm]
```
I applied to rotary, q/k/v/o projections, and LN affine params. For tokenmap I forced punctuation mappings to remain < src_vocab_size and contiguous with their block.
sam: Results after both fixes?
mira: After head reorder + vocab patch then int4 quant: ppl=1.95, ROUGE-L=42.1. That recovers near fp16. Isolated tests: reorder only -> ppl 2.02, ROUGE-L 39.8; vocab-only -> ppl 2.9, ROUGE-L 35.2. So both were contributing.
eli: Good catch. Can you add an auto-detect and conversion flags so next time we can fix automatically?
mira: Plan: add --fix-headstride flag that auto-detects even/odd interleave and reorders, plus --validate-vocab-shadowing which asserts mapped ids < src_vocab_size and flags large appended clusters in punctuation ranges. Also add tiny triage tools: tools/check_head_permutation.py and tools/check_vocab_shadow.py that output a small heatmap png artifact.
priya: Add CI unit test: run convert on a tiny model slice, run seed prompt "Summarize this" (16 tokens) and compute attention-position correlation; fail if corr drop >8% vs fp16 reference. Also add model-catalog metadata fields: 
"head_layout": "contiguous|even-interleave|odd-interleave|unknown" and "vocab_shadowing": "none|punctuation|append-cluster|other".
mira: I'll open a PR with the flags, detection heuristics, tools, CI test, and update maps/orpheusx_to_gemma_punct_v2.json with a note. I will also include exporter_git_sha in the conversion metadata so we can trace exporter versions.
ops-bot: ticket INF-3120 created: "OrpheusX-lite: head-stride interleave + punctuation remap" assigned to mira (P2).
sam: Also add a short onboarding checklist item: dump first 8 rotary heads and verify punctuation block before marking model ready.
mira: Yep, adding checklist and small smoke script to conversion tool. Will ping with PR link. Thanks :thumbsup:
